subject: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter & trust portal next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liang <emma@polarishealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: security intake and next steps

Hi Emma —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery focused on security and compliance:

- You confirmed Polaris Health requires SOC 2 Type II evidence for procurement review.
- Questions on GDPR residency and whether a BAA/PHI flow is required for the integration.
- You asked for a short bridge/interim attestation while the full Type II report is prepared.
- Security team will kick off a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) — you requested a link and an initial point of contact.

Next steps I mentioned on the call:
1) I can share an interim bridge letter and a temporary attestation for your procurement team to accept while we provide the full Type II report.
2) I will request Trust Portal access for Polaris so your security team can download artifacts (SOC report, control mappings, evidence).
3) Start the VSQ; I’ll send a secure link to your security inbox and monitor submissions.
4) If a BAA is required, we’ll route that to Legal — I’ve flagged for our counsel.

Attachments sent: Redwood-Interim-BridgeLetter-2027.pdf (attached), Redwood-Temporary-Attestation-2027.pdf (attached).
Trust portal invite: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/invite?org=polarishealth
VSQ starter link: https://app.redwood.ai/vsq/launch?company=polarishealth

Would you be able to confirm the security contact who should receive the portal invite and whether HIPAA/BAA will be needed for this integration? Also let me know the procurement timeline — you referenced a target PO by end of May.

Thanks — I’ll loop Lauren and Sean (security/CS) for handoff.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Liang <emma@polarishealth.com>

Cc: Polaris Health Security <security@polarishealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@polarishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security intake and next steps

Thanks Jonas — helpful recap.

Quick answers:
- Please send the Trust Portal invite to security@polarishealth.com (that mailbox is monitored by our infosec team).
- We do require a SOC 2 Type II report for final approval; an interim bridge letter is acceptable for procurement to move forward with a conditional PO.
- We are evaluating if a BAA is necessary — I’ll confirm by EOD tomorrow. If required, we’ll need a sample BAA and an estimated timeline for execution.
- For the VSQ, please include any screenshots of network segmentation or encryption-in-transit diagrams you can share up front.
- Audit period: we’d like the last 12 months of coverage and the auditor firm name.

Procurement timeline: aiming to finalize commercial terms the week of May 24; would like security intake closed before then.

Can you also confirm whether you support cross-region data residency controls for EU patients? We have some EU-scope data flows.

Emma Liang
Director, IT Security — Polaris Health
emma.liang@polarishealth.com

Hi Emma / Security team —

Thanks — and noted on procurement timing. A few items to make the security handoff easier:

1) Interim materials attached: Redwood-Interim-BridgeLetter-2027.pdf (short attestation describing scope) and Redwood-Temporary-Attestation-2027.pdf (control summary). These are intended to unblock procurement while we get the portal provisioned.

2) Trust Portal: I’ve created an invite for security@polarishealth.com. You should receive an email from Trust Portal (trust@redwood.ai) with one-click access — link: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/invite?org=polarishealth

3) SOC 2 Type II specifics: Our most recent Type II covers 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and was issued by NorthBridge Audit LLP. We will upload the full report to the portal under the Artifacts > SOC Reports folder.

4) VSQ: I’ve launched the questionnaire for Polaris (secure link above). We can pre-populate sections with a control mapping spreadsheet if that helps — I’m attaching a CSV template for quick inputs.

5) GDPR / data residency: We support customer-level routing and can restrict storage region for embeddings and logs; I’ve asked our solutions engineer (cc’d: lauren_bishop) to follow up with the architecture note.

6) BAA: If you confirm BAA requirement, I’ll route our standard BAA to your legal counsel. DocuSign link (sample) will be provided once Legal confirms the scope.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- Today: security@polarishealth.com receives Trust Portal invite and interim attestation. (DONE)
- By 5/10: Polaris completes VSQ initial pass.
- By 5/17: Redwood uploads any additional evidence requested from the VSQ.
- Week of 5/24: Target commercial close pending security OK.

If that timeline looks reasonable I’ll track tasks in the HubSpot deal and pull in legal as needed.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
